name: Palo Brunch Buttermilk Panna Cotta Pot with Strawberry Popping Pearls & Pistachio
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Silky set buttermilk-vanilla custard with seedless juice-filled popping pearls; only the pistachio crumble on top adds nut fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to hold the pistachio crumble topping (or scrape it off) and take a Lactaid for the buttermilk panna cotta.
